title: CYBRIK org_node v1 (D-1)
description: A node in the deployment's governance tree (ADR-0007 D-1; 02 §1.2). A TREE, not a DAG: at most one governance parent_id (nullable, null only for a deployment root); cross-branch relationships are exchange edges, never a second parent. Each node belongs to exactly ONE tenant (OD-1). tier is an ordinal into a configured ladder — the product ships NO fixed tier names. status has no 'deleted' value: a referenced node is archived, never hard-deleted. An 'external' boundary node (A05) has no parent_id and is not in the internal tier ladder (INV-2). $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-G (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

parent_id.description: The single governance parent. null ONLY for a deployment root. Tree, not DAG: exactly one parent (02 §1.2, §8). The parent MUST be in the same tenant and MUST be an internal node (cross-tenant edges and external ancestors are rejected — enforced structurally by cybrik.org-edge.v1 and at runtime; a node's own parent_id cannot be resolved against itself here).

tier.description: Ordinal depth into the configured tier ladder. An administrative NAME (e.g. 'province') is NOT a valid value — tiers are data, expressed as an integer ordinal only (02 §2.1).

tenant_binding.description: The single tenant this node belongs to (OD-1: exactly one tenant per node). org_node never weakens tenant isolation; cross-node data movement re-checks tenant (FC-2).

labels.description: Locale-catalog KEY for this node's display name (resolved VI/EN by the UI). No hard-coded administrative string is stored.

jurisdiction.description: Optional residency/jurisdiction policy-as-data for this node (deny-by-default; OD-4).

allOf.$comment: INV-2 / boundary: an external (A05) node is not in the internal tier ladder and never has a governance parent — it is an exchange peer, never a child/ancestor of internal nodes.
